cohort: The study included 42,681 deliveries from seven health system hospitals between January 2016 and August 2019.
finding: Among 42,681 deliveries, SMM was rare (1.3%), but route-specific and neonatal complications were much more common (12.9% for vaginal, 19.7% for cesarean, 20.2% for neonatal complications), with significant racial disparities observed and various maternal and delivery characteristics identified as risk factors.
mod_finding: Other complication rates were 12.9% for vaginal and 19.7% for cesarean deliveries, and cesarean delivery was a risk factor for both SMM and neonatal complications.
